title: molt.toml.example enables a terminal liberator that does not exist
body:
templates/molt.toml.example enables a liberator named `terminal` for Linux. There is no such liberator in liberators/, so a stack copied from the example fails doctor on Linux.

Fix: name the terminal liberators that exist: gnome-terminal for Linux, terminal-app and iterm2 for macOS, and alacritty. Add a test that every liberator named in molt.toml.example and in the molt-user skeleton's molt.toml exists, checked against a listing of liberators/ made by the test itself.

Found by ac's docs review; vc checked it.
